# testdata/form

Example trumpet-form clips. Audio is not meaningful in the posture clips below, except `posture_explainer.mp4` (spoken explanation).

- `good_posture_side.mp4`: 7.05 s, 360x640 @ 29.88 fps, side view. Good-posture example: upright head and torso, trumpet roughly horizontal; contains two takes (maroon shirt, then black jacket) with a pause between. Source: Jameson, 2026-10-11. Audio not meaningful.
  - Expected form result: no flags.
  - Measured (AI off, trumpet): view side (view_ratio 0.6443), 71 of 71 frames tracked, no flags. Skipped rules: trumpet_elbows_pinned (not_for_view), trumpet_cheeks_puffed and trumpet_smile_embouchure (not_visible).
- `bad_posture_side.mp4`: 0.26 s, 360x640 @ 30 fps, side view. Bad-posture example, held and static. Source: Jameson, 2026-10-11. Audio not meaningful.
  - Expected form result: flags for forward head, rounded back, forward lean, and the bell dropped to about waist height.
  - Measured (AI off, trumpet): no flags. At 0.26 s the clip is only 3 sampled frames, too short for view detection ("only 3 usable frames, assuming a front view"; view front, view_ratio null), so the side-view rules never ran. Skipped rules: trumpet_cheeks_puffed and trumpet_smile_embouchure (not_visible). The clip needs to be lengthened, or short clips handled in the pipeline, before it can test the posture rules.
- `neck_bad_then_good_side.mp4`: 10.64 s, 1920x1080 @ 29.97 fps, 2.7 MB, close-up (head, neck, shoulders and upper arms; hips never in frame) of a trumpet player in side view, facing image left. Source file: "First have bad posture, second half good posture.mp4", added by the owner (Jameson) 2026-10-11; no watermark, credits or title card, Apple "Core Media" encode. Audio not meaningful.
  - Content: bad neck/head posture first, good after. The switch is at about 4.6-5.0 s by measured head pitch (about 12 degrees down to about 0 over those 0.4 s); the file's midpoint is 5.3 s. Frame inspection by eye was inconclusive.
  - Expected form result: a trumpet_head_down flag (side version) in the bad half (0 to about 4.8 s) and no flags after.
  - Measured (AI off, trumpet): view side (view_ratio 0.2975, far below the 1.36-1.96 the threshold was fitted on, because the close-up crops the body), 107 of 107 frames tracked, no flags. Skipped rules: slouching (not_visible: no hips, so no torso lean), trumpet_elbows_pinned (not_for_view), trumpet_cheeks_puffed and trumpet_smile_embouchure (not_visible: face found in 10% of frames).
  - Why nothing flags: the baseline (first 2 s) is inside the bad half, so it absorbs the fault. Baseline head_pitch is 25.2 degrees (t=0-1 s reads 26 degrees while the trumpet is still down), so the head_down threshold is 40.2 degrees. Per-second median head_pitch: 13, 10, 12, 12 degrees at t=1-4 s (bad), then -2, -5, -7, -5, -4 degrees at t=5-9 s (good), a drop of about 17 degrees. neck_side is 0.31-0.32 in the bad half and 0.32-0.36 in the good half, so the side shoulders_raised rule does not separate them either. The clip would flag at the 15-degree delta only if the baseline came from the good half.
- `posture_explainer.mp4`: 53.5 s, 1920x1080 @ 29.97 fps, 9.9 MB, a trumpet player in a hotel room talking through standing and seated posture; mixed framing (front, side, chest-cropped, seated side view). Source file: "Posture explanations.mp4", added by the owner (Jameson) 2026-10-11; no watermark, credits or title card, Apple "Core Media" encode. Audio is meaningful: it is the explanation. Reference material, not a test case for the rules.
  - Spoken criteria: stand straight with feet shoulder width apart and the head over the centre, not slumping; do not lock the knees (slightly bent, weight on the balls of the feet, not back on the heels); feet level, neither foot forward; seated, head over the centre, feet parallel and flat, thighs parallel to the floor, knees at right angles.
  - Our rules cover only the head and torso criteria (head over centre via trumpet_head_down, slumping via slouching). Knees, feet, weight distribution and chair position are not checked: only pose landmarks 0-24 are kept.
  - Measured (AI off, trumpet): view side (view_ratio 0.4989), 403 of 535 frames tracked (0.753), slouching flags at 11.9-13.7 s and 16.6-17.7 s and shoulders_raised at 12.7-13.7 s, from the chest-cropped and mixed-view parts of the clip. These are not meaningful results for the clip.
